newsitem.title: USA: MBIA muni volume drops 15.5 pct to $6 bln in Q3.
newsitem.headline: MBIA muni volume drops 15.5 pct to $6 bln in Q3.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Monday it insured $6 billion of municipal bonds in the third quarter of 1996, a 15.5 percent drop from the $7.1 billion insured in the same period last year.
For the year to date, MBIA, a unit of MBIA Inc, insured $23.6 billion, a 27 percent increase over the $18.6 billion insured in the first nine months of 1995.
The quarterly figure was below the $6.9 billion insured by municipal market rival AMBAC Indemnity Corp, a unit of AMBAC Inc, in the same period.
MBIA said it was the first time since third quarter 1993 that AMBAC topped MBIA in the quarterly market share rankings.
AMBAC's third quarter results were a 41 percent increase over the third quarter of 1995.
AMBAC was up 2 points on the New York Stock Exchange to 62-1/8 and MBIA was up 3/8 to 90-1/2.
